title: AWKUM Bye-Election Notification — Associate Professor Cadre, Syndicate Constituency No. 22(1)(i)
labels: Election For The Syndicate Constituency No. 22(1)(j)
text:
Bye-Election Notification — Associate Professor Cadre

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan | Syndicate Constituency No. 22(1)(i) | Residual Period: 20-08-2026 to 16-10-2027

********************
***********************************

F.No. 1(1)-Reg-1/AWKUM/2026/6079 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1f0mlkSFWzQ1zOpdfaOuHoqNQ5uop-K8-/view?usp=drive_link)
, dated August 11, 2026:
Consequent upon promotion of Dr. Mohsin Jamal, Associate Professor (Tenure) as Professor (Tenure), and in line with Section 3(2) of the AWKUM Election Statutes, 2016, Mr. Muhammad Changaiz Khan, Superintendent, Registrar's Office, is hereby nominated as Returning Officer to conduct bye-election of Associate Professor cadre for the Syndicate Constituency No. 22(1)(i) for the residual period, i.e. (w.e.f 20-8-2026 to 16-10-2027).

F.No. 1(1)-Reg-1/AWKUM/2026/6080 (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1f0mlkSFWzQ1zOpdfaOuHoqNQ5uop-K8-/view?usp=drive_link)
, dated August 11, 2026:
It is notified for the information of all concerned that By-Election for the Syndicate Constituency No. 22(1)(i) for electing "one Associate Professor of the University to be elected by the teachers of the cadres in the manner as may be prescribed by Statutes" as members of the Syndicate for the residual period, i.e. (w.e.f 20-8-2026 to 16-10-2027), will be held as per the schedule given below.

Election Schedule

# | Activity | Date
1 | Issuing of revised list (changes only) | 11-08-2026
2 | Receipt of nomination papers | 12-08-2026
3 | Scrutiny of nomination papers | 13-08-2026
4 | Issuing of list of validly nominated candidates | 17-08-2026
5 | Withdrawal of nomination papers | 18-08-2026
6 | Issuing of list of contesting candidates | 18-08-2026
7 | Issuing of ballot papers to the Presiding Officer | 19-08-2026
8 | Election (09:00 AM to 02:00 PM) | 20-08-2026
9 | Announcement of election result in the prescribed form | 20-08-2026

Note: The date may be changed by the Returning Officer with the approval of the Election Authority as the circumstances may require. Returning Officer: Mr. Muhammad Changaiz Khan, Superintendent, Registrar's Office.

Election Nomination Form

Download, fill, and submit as per the schedule above.

Download Nomination Form (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nG5cvfLUuZz4RUSWLjaPK3Pjbylot-BA/export?format=docx&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
